label: Date of First Exposure to Treatment
derivation: Minimum of EX.EXSTDTC converted to numeric date for each USUBJID; partial-date imputation: sponsor convention - REVIEW

label: Date of Last Exposure to Treatment
derivation: Maximum of EX.EXENDTC converted to numeric date for each USUBJID; partial-date imputation: sponsor convention - REVIEW

label: Age Group 1
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: Age category (<65, 65-80, >80). If AGE < 65 then '<65'; else if AGE <= 80 then '65-80'; else '>80'

label: Age Group 2
derivation: Not defined in SAP; set to null

label: Age Group 2 (N)
derivation: Not defined in SAP; set to null

label: Race (N)
derivation: Numeric code assigned to each unique value of RACE in alphabetical order

label: Safety Population Flag
derivation: Per SAP Section 6: 'All patients randomized and known to have taken at least one dose of randomized drug'. Y if USUBJID in DM where ARM ne '' and USUBJID in EX where EX.EXSTDTC is not null; else N

label: Intent-To-Treat Population Flag
derivation: Per SAP Section 6: 'All patients randomized'. Y if DM.ARM ne ''; else N

label: Efficacy Population Flag
derivation: Per SAP Section 6: 'All patients who were randomized and took drug, and have at least 1 post-baseline measure for both ADAS-Cog and CIBIC+'. Y if SAFFL='Y' and exists post-baseline ADAS-Cog and CIBIC+ records in efficacy dataset; else N

label: Completers Population Flag
derivation: Per SAP Section 6: 'All patients in the efficacy population who completed their Week 24 visit (Visit 12)'. Y if EFFFL='Y' and DS.DSDECOD='COMPLETED' at VISITNUM=12; else N

label: Discontinued from Study Flag
derivation: Y if DS.DSDECOD ne 'COMPLETED' for the last DS record per USUBJID; else N

label: End of Study Status
derivation: DS.DSDECOD from the last DS record per USUBJID (sorted by DS.DSDTC, DS.DSSEQ); mapped to controlled terminology: COMPLETED, DISCONTINUED, ONGOING

label: Standardized Disposition Term
derivation: DS.DSDECOD from the last DS record per USUBJID

label: Reason for Discontinuation from Study
derivation: DS.DSDECOD from the last DS record per USUBJID where DSDECOD ne 'COMPLETED'; else null

label: Duration of Disease (Months)
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: 'computed as months between date of Week -2 (Visit 1) and date of onset of first definite symptoms of Alzheimer\'s Disease'. (SV.SVSTDTC at VISITNUM=1) - (MH.MHSTDTC where MHTERM indicates onset of Alzheimer\'s symptoms) / 30.4375

label: Years of Education
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: 'Years of education'. Derived from supplemental qualification or DM.SCOBID if collected; else set to null

label: Baseline Mini-Mental State Examination Score
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: 'Baseline comparisons across treatment groups for the Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE)'. LB.LBSTRESN where LBTESTCD='MMSE' and VISITNUM=3 (Week 0 Visit 3) and LBBLFL='Y'; if multiple, average

label: Baseline Weight (kg)
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: 'Weight, height, BMI at Baseline (Visit 3 for weight and BMI, Visit 1 for height)'. VS.VSSTRESN where VSTESTCD='WEIGHT' and VISITNUM=3 and VSBLFL='Y'

label: Baseline Height (cm)
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: 'Weight, height, BMI at Baseline (Visit 3 for weight and BMI, Visit 1 for height)'. VS.VSSTRESN where VSTESTCD='HEIGHT' and VISITNUM=1 and VSBLFL='Y'

label: Baseline Body Mass Index (kg/m2)
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: 'BMI at Baseline (Visit 3 for weight and BMI, Visit 1 for height)'. WEIGHTBL / (HEIGHTBL/100)^2

label: Baseline BMI Category
derivation: Per SAP Section 9.2: 'BMI category (BMI<25, BMI 25-<30, BMI>=30)'. If BMIBL < 25 then 'BMI<25'; else if BMIBL < 30 then 'BMI 25-<30'; else 'BMI>=30'
